propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain rooted at the reconciler package level to allow both Jira Cloud and Data Center adapters to share it while maintaining the J7 sibling-adapter seal that forbids cross-imports between adapters/jira/ and adapters/jira_datacenter/
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would break the J7 seal by forcing adapters/jira_datacenter/ to import from a sibling adapter package

moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core consumers (inbound_differ.py and peer_state.py) are not permitted to import from the jira_family layer
the backend-neutrality sweep exemption should document the permanent architectural constraint rather than describe relocation as future work
the exemption rationale must explain that the root location preserves the shared mapper guarantee without opening a forbidden adapter-to-adapter edge
